newsitem.title: UK: UK police reopen M5 motorway junctions after alert.
newsitem.headline: UK police reopen M5 motorway junctions after alert.

text.p: Police reopened a 20-mile stretch of the M5 motorway in western England on Tuesday afternoon, after closing it earlier amid a spate of suspected IRA bomb alerts around the country.
Gloucestershire police had closed junctions 11 through 14 of the M5 for nearly three hours after a passing motorist reported a "suspicious incident" on the motorway, a police spokeswoman said.
She declined to describe the incident, but said police were continuing investigations after reopening the motorway at about 1445 GMT.
"All sections of the M5 through Gloucestershire are now open," she said.
Earlier in the day, a series of bomb alerts closed motorways and airports in southern England. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
